description: INSPECTION ONLY — read a blueprint's overlay code by id (from list_blueprints) to understand how it works. To USE a blueprint, apply it: apply_blueprint_widgets for a widget-set (materializes its widgets byte-exact with the command-frame plumbing intact AND provisions the custom tables its code depends on), create_flow_from_blueprint for an FBB. Do NOT re-type code from this tool into write_flow_files — that silently drops the vetted plumbing and leaves its tables unprovisioned. `tables` (when present) lists the custom tables the code binds to by exact name. For a WHOLE-FLOW blueprint this returns the screen manifest WITHOUT file bytes by default — an entire app is far too large to read this way, and you never need to: instantiation copies it server-side. Pass includeFiles: true only to audit the source.
name: flow_get_blueprint
title: Inspect one blueprint's code
